We present a novel problem in which we wish jointly to perform scene understanding, object recognition, and activity recognition in scenarios where multiple people are simultaneously wearing body-worn video cameras while a third person static camera also captures their actions.

1) a novel Siamese Convolution Neural Network architecture is proposed for joint embedding of first- and third-person videos; 2) a novel triplet loss function is proposed that considers spatial- and motion-domain cues; and 3) the new architecture and loss function outperform several baselines in a novel task of identifying first-person camera wearers in third-person videos.
